items.headline: Nucor Corporation Reports Earnings Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended October 03, 2026
items.summary: Nucor Corporation reported earnings results for the third quarter and nine months ended October 03, 2026. For the third quarter, the company reported sales was USD 11,249 million compared to USD 8,521 million a year ago.
